title: Introduce pluginified RAG starter templates and typed telemetry walkthrough
author: Maya Chen
description:
Problem and motivation: teams keep copying monolithic RAG examples that mix retrieval, tool-calling, and telemetry. That makes it hard to swap components, add custom telemetry, or reuse parts across languages. This PR introduces a plugin-first quickstart layout and a short walkthrough doc that shows how to wire typed telemetry hooks into the Redwood Console ingestion pipeline.

What this PR does: adds a small, opinionated plugin architecture for RAG quickstarts (templates + runtime shims) that separates three concerns: retrieval adapters, tool-binding plugins, and telemetry hooks. Provides two concrete starter templates (TypeScript and Python) and a lightweight cross-language telemetry shim so teams can emit step-level events with a stable typed contract. Also updates the quickstarts docs page with a guided walkthrough and adds a smoke CI job and unit tests for the templates.

Highlights: - New layout under quickstarts/pluginified-rag with clear plugin boundaries - templates/ts-starter.yaml and templates/python-starter.yaml: minimal config-first starters you can deploy locally - examples/rag-plugin-adapter: canonical adapters showing how to implement retrieval/adapter/tool-binding/telemetry in TS and Python - docs/quickstarts/pluginified-rag.md: end-to-end walkthrough including migration notes and common pitfalls - typed-telemetry contract v1: small JSON schema and TypeScript types included as artifacts - small smoke test and CI job to catch basic runtime regressions

Checklist: - [x] add starter templates and examples - [x] add docs walkthrough and migration notes - [x] add CI smoke job and tests - [x] include typed telemetry contract + example ingestion snippet - [x] basic smoke runs pass on GHA (rerun after lint fixes)

Backward compatibility and migration: The starters are additive; they don't change existing quickstarts. Migration guidance is in the new docs page with an example diff that extracts a retrieval block into a retrieval plugin.

Notes for reviewers: pay particular attention to the typed telemetry contract (docs/quickstarts/pluginified-rag.md section) and the small Node worker implementation in examples/rag-plugin-adapter/ts/main.ts. I included a short raw payload example for Redwood Console ingestion; the Console team suggested this shape in ENG-2045.

Related: ENG-2045, PM-789.

release_notes: Add pluginified RAG quickstart: new starter templates (TypeScript, Python), example plugin adapters, typed telemetry contract v1, and docs walkthrough for migration and customization. Includes smoke CI to ensure starters remain runnable.
notes_for_ops: The telemetry shim emits a small event batch over HTTPS to the Console ingestion endpoint. See docs/quickstarts/pluginified-rag.md for the required API key scope and recommended rate limits (10 rps per starter by default).
testing_instructions:
1) cd quickstarts/pluginified-rag && ./dev up (local docker compose)
2) follow README to run ts-starter and python-starter
3) run tests: pnpm test tests/quickstarts/pluginified-rag-smoke.test.ts or pytest examples/rag-plugin-adapter/python
4) observe events in Console: filter by telemetry.contract:typed-telemetry-v1
